question: Do the two bidirectional task-conditioned rank-four response programs remain sufficient and selective under 10% cue-source noise?

authority.clean_rank4: Own-task rank four is the minimal forward program and passes reverse OOD at .80068/.80023; cross-task rank four is a strong causal negative control.
authority.full_rank46_noise: The full rank-eight pooled interface on the same 46-site support passes three noise seeds in both directions, with minimum behavior .800048.

evaluation: For seeds 1729, 2718, and 3141, perturb only the exchanged cue embedding by 10% of its clean displacement norm, run the frozen 46-site graph in both directions, and install each row's frozen task-specific rank-four response modes. Controls use temporal rank-four modes.

predictions.pred_a_authority_hash_noise_tripwire_fin: Authorities/projector hashes reproduce, fit/evaluation IDs are disjoint, noise ratios are .099-.101, values are finite, and exactly 43 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_all_noisy_rank4_coordinates_trans: Every seed and direction has mean coordinate projection at least .95 for both tasks and worst site residual at most .20.
predictions.pred_c_all_noisy_rank4_behaviors_transfe: Every seed and direction has both task behavior projections at least .80 and worst target residual at most .15.
predictions.pred_d_all_noisy_rank4_controls_are_sele: Every seed and direction has margin RMS at most .10, median full-vocabulary KL at most .02, and zero top-one flips.
predictions.pred_e_rank4_seed_and_direction_stabilit: Within-direction seed ranges and paired direction gaps for each task are at most .08.

decision: A-E passing promotes two task-conditioned rank-four programs as the robust response realization of the rank46 interface. Any behavior miss retains bidirectional rank four only on clean OOD and the robust executor remains full rank eight; no threshold or rank retuning follows.
